title: The Path, founded by Tony Robbins and Calm alums, hopes to offer safer AI therapy
brief: The Path, a mental health AI startup founded by alumni from Tony Robbins' organization and meditation app Calm, has developed an AI model that scored 95 on the Vera-MH mental health safety benchmark—significantly outperforming consumer chatbots that top out at 65. The company aims to position itself as a safer alternative for AI-driven therapy applications.
